decisions.why: a colposcope (KAPS SOM 52) and a hysteroscopy system (XION) are gynaecological examination devices
a HALO system, halo head ring, titanium skull pins and traction tongs are trauma & fixation devices

examples (KAPS microscope range for ENT & Laboratory, Global Surgical Corporation dental microscopes, Zumax, Mediworks) are surgical operating microscopes — capital theatre/OR equipment used across ENT, dental and ophthalmic procedures, not owned by any single clinical speciality
